run_summary: JR Central has announced the integration of real-time Tokaido Shinkansen operation data into the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app, and is conducting additional security camera trials on Shinkansen trains. Several regional tourism campaigns and minor events were also announced.

candidates.title: Tokaido Shinkansen Real-Time Data Now Available on Japan Travel by NAVITIME App
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has enabled real-time operation status for the Tokaido Shinkansen within the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app.
candidates.why_it_matters: International travelers can now receive more accurate, real-time updates on train delays or service changes directly within a popular navigation app.
candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Shinkansen status.
